name: infrachecks-metrics
title: InfraChecks Metrics: export metrics as InfluxDB line protocol
author: InfraChecks
description: Sends every new service metric from Livestatus to InfluxDB, VictoriaMetrics or any InfluxDB line protocol endpoint, configured in ~/etc/infrachecks/metrics.ini. Run bin/infrachecks-metrics every minute as the site user. GPLv2.
